text: Minervini's WAIT and the volume clause are not answered by my method, and I will not claim they are. My entry is mechanical: buy over bar_high, trailed (C27, C31); close_vs_swing_high_pct 6.96 past the break is the signal in my position system, not a chase (C26, R10). day_vol 0.88 is a C25 caution only; my confirmation is COM (subcomponents.flow.cmf), not served, plus TIF proxy elder_pattern ACCELERATION, which confirms (R14). rs_rank_pct 94.87. A volume clause is the volume seats' to add. I move on elder_pattern leaving ACCELERATION or a close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d) (C29).
